title: Minimal issues and low-effort driving remarks
summary: This topic combines praise about having few faults or performance issues with complaints about unwanted driver-assist behavior, while several fragments are too context-poor to interpret confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews say the car is enjoyable to drive and has hardly any faults or performance issues.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention problems absent in a previous car and criticize the car for feeling too self-driving and reducing driver involvement.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention hearing speech, low-effort driving, lack of powerless moments, or vague commentary, but there is not enough context to assign clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: The topic is lexically loose because 'hardly' appears across unrelated subjects rather than one clearly coherent aspect.
Several fragments are too short or context-poor to determine whether they express praise, criticism, or neither.
The sample is small and stratified, so it should not be treated as representative of all reviews about this topic.
